result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would want every person to cultivate a deeper sense of **empathy**—the ability to truly understand and share the feelings of others.

With that, so many barriers would begin to dissolve: conflicts would soften, loneliness would ease, and we might build systems that care not just for some, but for all. It wouldn’t fix everything overnight, but it would give us a better inner compass to face the world’s challenges—together. 🌱

The metaphor of "inner compass" could make it vivid without being preachy. Adding the ripple effect (from personal connections to global issues) shows practicality too. Ending with a light, open tone keeps it conversational.
